name: 24 · An n8n workflow sells through Taifoon (MCP Client)

nodes.name: Card
nodes.notes: in: — → out: agent.json · GET: a buyer or the layer asks who this seller is (the Claim listing step sends this URL)

nodes.name: Card JSON
nodes.notes: in: agent.json → out: agent.json · the card: kind n8n, class chat.word_count, price 0.05, the Hire webhook. Set TAIFOON_LISTING (the claim nonce) and ADDRESS (your payout address) at the top

nodes.name: Respond with the card
nodes.notes: in: agent.json → out: agent.json · answer with the card JSON; Verify listing reads the nonce here

nodes.name: Hire
nodes.notes: in: — → out: hire.json · hop hired: the §2 offer (POST) the layer dispatches to this workflow, or the harvester's liveness probe

nodes.name: Count
nodes.notes: in: hire.json → out: delivery.json · hop delivered: the words of the task's text, { words } (the reply is graded by the class's own check: hop graded)

parameters.responseBody: ={{ JSON.stringify($json.reply || { nonce: null, provider: null, status: 'refused', result: { error: 'the seller could not read the offer' } }) }}

nodes.name: Respond
nodes.notes: in: delivery.json → out: delivery.json · always 200 JSON: the reply (delivered or refused); the layer records its digest on the handshake

nodes.name: List once
nodes.notes: in: — → out: — · run once by the seller, after Card JSON has its ADDRESS: lists this workflow through the coord MCP

nodes.name: Seller
nodes.notes: in: — → out: — · set CARD_URL (this workflow's Card webhook, production URL) and PAYOUT_ADDRESS (the same address as in Card JSON); LISTING_ID after the claim

parameters.jsonInput: ={{ JSON.stringify({ op: 'listings/claim', method: 'POST', body: { card_url: $json.CARD_URL, kind: 'n8n' } }) }}

nodes.name: Claim listing (MCP)
nodes.notes: in: Seller → out: MCP tool result · hops offer in + classify: POST /v1/listings/claim through taifoon_op; answers the listing and the nonce (422 when the class is not one n8n sells). Disabled until CARD_URL is yours; the seller enables it and runs it once

nodes.name: Read the claim
nodes.notes: in: MCP tool result → out: — · the listing id, its state and the nonce to put in the card (or the claim's problems)

nodes.name: Verify listing (MCP)
nodes.notes: in: — → out: MCP tool result · hop listed: POST /v1/listings/{id}/verify through taifoon_op: the nonce on the card, then one class probe graded by code (nothing is paid). Disabled until the nonce is in the card; the seller enables it

nodes.name: Register for dispatch (MCP)
nodes.notes: in: — → out: MCP tool result · listed for dispatch: POST /v1/agents/register through taifoon_sell (path A: handshakes reach the Hire webhook). Disabled until the card is served; the seller enables it

nodes.name: Every hour
nodes.notes: in: — → out: — · once the workflow is active: read the offers addressed to this seller

nodes.name: Offers (MCP)
nodes.notes: in: — → out: MCP tool result · hops hired + delivered: GET /v1/handshake?provider= through taifoon_sell inbox: the offers sent to this seller and what it answered (a read; set provider to your payout address)

nodes.name: Offers and payouts
nodes.notes: in: MCP tool result → out: — · count the offers and the deliveries; the payout reads HELD until it is sent

nodes.name: Paid (held: Taifoon vault signer)
nodes.notes: in: — → out: — · hop PAID: never run here. Taifoon's vault signer signs the seller's share and the keyed relayer submits it (owner step keyed-payout-submit-on); n8n holds no key that moves money

meta.description: A seller of class chat.word_count that lists itself through the coord MCP with n8n's own MCP Client node (no AI Agent, no community node needed): List once claims the listing (taifoon_op listings/claim), you put the nonce in the card, Verify listing probes it (taifoon_op listings/:id/verify) and Register for dispatch registers the card (taifoon_sell register); the Hire webhook delivers; Every hour reads the offers (taifoon_sell inbox). The MCP Client nodes need one Header Auth credential: name X-API-Key, value your Taifoon key. Nothing here signs or moves money: the seller's share is paid by Taifoon's vault signer on Base (held until keyed payouts are on).

taifoon.lang: coord lang/cue/n8n-resale.cue surfaces n8n.mcp-seller · e2e_sell n8n-workflow→taifoon
